title: 第19章 全部解决第20章 我就是死也不会做仆役
slug: 刚穿越就继承了宗主之位
lines: 铁剑宗宗主将他所知道的关于清风宗的事情都说了出来，没有一点隐瞒。事关生死存亡，他自然不敢有所隐瞒。
“这么说，清风宗有两名先天武者了？”血杀长老问道。
“是的，这位大人，小人已经确认过了，另外一名先天强者叫归海一刀，是清风宗长老，也不知道从哪里就突然冒出来的。”铁剑宗宗主如实说道。
血杀长老点了点头，心中暗道看来分舵杀手之所以失败，就是折损在这个叫归海一刀的手里。
“你就不好奇我们来自哪里？”血杀长老突然问道，说完目光幽幽的看着铁剑宗宗主。
铁剑宗宗主身体一颤，他不是傻子，知道对方起了杀心，若是回答不好，恐怕今天就要交代在这里了。
他连忙说道：“诸位大人来自哪里，小人不敢打听，也不敢猜测。”
血杀长老直盯盯地看着铁剑宗宗主，过了好一会，收回目光，说道：“算你运气好，本长老今天还不想杀人。”
说完，血杀长老起身，带着两个执事走了。
铁剑宗宗主与众长老皆都松了一口气。
三长老小心翼翼地问道：“也不知道这些杀神是从哪里来的？”
铁剑宗宗主瞪了他一眼，喝道：“慎言！他们，我们是惹不起的。”
铁剑宗宗主不是傻子，从那三人身上那么浓郁的杀气就能看出这些人是杀手，再加上他们打听的是清风宗，联想数天前虎拳门买杀手刺杀秦叶一事，那么这些人来自哪里不言而喻。
在去清风宗的路上，一个血杀执事问道：“十长老，为何不灭了铁剑宗？”
血杀长老幽幽说道：“这次目标是清风宗，铁剑宗一个小门小派，灭他们，脏了本长老的手。”
自始至终，血杀长老都不将铁剑宗这样的小宗门放在眼里。
另一执事皱眉说道：“若是他们向清风宗通风报信呢？”
血杀长老哈哈大笑道：“他们没有这个胆子，而且他们巴不得我们将清风宗给灭了。如果他们真的通风报信，那真好，让清风宗做好准备，本长老正好将他们一网打尽。”
当天，晚上血杀长老与两执事悄无声息地就到了清风宗。
血杀长老与两执事并没有立刻进入清风宗，只是站在清风宗附近，监视清风宗的举动。
到了后半夜，血杀长老感觉时机到了，便派了一个执事先进去探路。这个执事认为十长老太过于小心了，清风宗这样的小门小派，即使有先天坐镇，最多也是先天低阶，自己三人绝对能轻松覆灭清风宗，哪用得着这么麻烦。
不过，对方毕竟是十长老，身份高贵，不是自己能得罪的，当下也不敢反驳。
这个执事轻轻松松的就闯进了清风宗山门，看着这破烂的山门，眼角一抽，这也太破旧了，而且连一个护宗大阵都没有，甚至连一个看门弟子都没有，这清风宗得多穷啊。
他光明正大的就走进了清风宗，果然没有任何人阻拦。
清风宗非常安静，他放开神念，感应了一下，很快就找到了秦叶的卧室，嘴角露出一丝残忍的笑容：“找到了。”
然而，忽然一道黑影闪过，在他还没有反应过来的时候，啪的一声，他就被人打晕了。
归海一刀的身影从黑幕中显现出来，看了一眼，抓着他身体就离开了。
血杀长老与另外一个执事等了一会儿，见派出的人还没有回来，微微皱眉，这么长时间了，还没有回来，不会出什么事了吧。
content_en:
The leader of the Iron Sword Sect told everything he knew about the Qingfeng Sect without hiding anything. It was a matter of life and death, so he naturally didn't dare to hide anything.
"So, Qingfeng Sect has two innate warriors?" Elder Xuesha asked.
"Yes, sir, I have already confirmed that there is another innate strong man named Gui Hai Yida. He is an elder of the Qingfeng Sect and he suddenly appeared from nowhere." The leader of the Iron Sword Sect said truthfully.
Elder Xuesha nodded, secretly thinking that it seemed that the reason why the split-rudder killer failed was because he fell into the hands of this man named Gui Hai Yida.
"Aren't you curious about where we come from?" Elder Xuesha asked suddenly. After speaking, he looked at the master of the Iron Sword Sect with a faint look.
The leader of the Iron Sword Sect trembled. He was not a fool. He knew that the other party had murderous intentions. If he didn't answer well, he might have to explain it here today.
He quickly said: "Where the adults are from, I don't dare to ask or guess."
Elder Xuesha stared at the leader of the Iron Sword Sect. After a while, he looked away and said, "You're lucky, I don't want to kill anyone today."
After saying that, Elder Xuesha stood up and left with the two deacons.
The leader of the Iron Sword Sect and all the elders breathed a sigh of relief.
The third elder asked cautiously: "I don't know where these killing gods come from?"
The leader of the Iron Sword Sect glared at him and shouted: "Be careful! We cannot afford to offend them."
The leader of the Iron Sword Sect is not a fool. From the strong murderous aura in those three people, it can be seen that these people are killers. In addition, they are inquiring about the Qingfeng Sect. Thinking of the Tiger Fist Sect buying a killer to assassinate Qin Ye a few days ago, it is self-evident where these people come from.
On the way to Qingfeng Sect, a blood-killing deacon asked: "Tenth Elder, why didn't you destroy the Iron Sword Sect?"
Elder Xue Kill said quietly: "This time the target is Qingfeng Sect, a small sect of Iron Sword Sect. To destroy them will dirty my elder's hands."
From the beginning to the end, Elder Xuesha never paid attention to small sects like Iron Sword Sect.
Another deacon frowned and said, "What if they tipped off the Qingfeng Sect?"
Elder Xuesha laughed loudly and said: "They don't have the courage, and they want us to destroy Qingfeng Sect. If they really tip off the news, that would be great. Let Qingfeng Sect be prepared, and I will kill them all in one fell swoop."
That day, the elder and the two deacons arrived at Qingfeng Sect quietly at night.
Elder Xuesha and the two deacons did not immediately enter the Qingfeng Sect, but stood near the Qingfeng Sect and monitored the Qingfeng Sect's actions.
In the middle of the night, Elder Xuesha felt that the time had come, so he sent a deacon to explore the way. This deacon thinks that the ten elders are too cautious. Even if a small sect like Qingfeng Sect has an innate person in charge, they are at most innately low-level. The three of them can definitely destroy Qingfeng Sect easily, so there is no need to go to such trouble.
However, the other party was the tenth elder after all, with a noble status. He was not someone he could offend, and he did not dare to refute him at the moment.
The deacon broke into the Qingfeng Sect's mountain gate easily. Looking at the shabby mountain gate, his eyes twitched. It was too shabby, and there was not even a sect-protecting formation, not even a gatekeeper disciple. How poor the Qingfeng Sect was.
He walked into Qingfeng Sect openly and as expected, no one stopped him.
The Qingfeng Sect was very quiet. He let go of his mind, sensed it, and soon found Qin Ye's bedroom. A cruel smile appeared on the corner of his mouth: "Found it."
However, suddenly a black shadow flashed across, and before he could react, he was knocked unconscious with a snap.
Gui Hai Yida's figure appeared from the black screen, took one look at him, grabbed his body and left.
Elder Xuesha and the other deacon waited for a while, and frowned slightly when they saw that the person they sent had not returned yet. They had not come back after such a long time, so something must have happened.
